source_notes: FCS score and efficiency components are fitted jointly with FBS teams.
FCS efficiency priors regress prior-season shared-scale estimates.
The cross-division margin layer is trained only on FBS-versus-FCS games.
Annual features are preseason inputs; in-season outcomes are excluded from them.

Inherited score ratings are blended toward a leakage-safe learned preseason program-strength rating according to roster, quarterback, unit, and staff continuity; current-season games return the blend toward observed score strength.
A bounded early-season large-gap interaction is learned from historical scores and fades over the opening weeks; betting lines are not model inputs.
Confirmed player-availability overrides supersede stale portal destinations without modifying the original CFBD snapshots.
Roster continuity includes skill-player usage, experience-weighted unit retention, and NFL draft departures; it fades as current-season plays accrue.
Published returning-production rates are capped by roster-verified contributor and quarterback retention to handle late departures.
1 team uses source-linked primary-OL and/or on-field staff continuity overrides where public API snapshots lack starter and assistant-coach roles.
Live training uses confirmed final scores and available advanced stats without a kickoff buffer; model as_of records the training cutoff.
